sources.excerpt: Himmelstrutz Elektro Art FUGAZI Junior Fuzz Home News Amps Pedals Custom Shop Download About Contact Himmelstrutz Elektro Art FUGAZI Jr. – Compact Tone Powerhouse Fugazi Alu Box/Blackface Not Just Another Fuzz! Meet the Himmelstrutz FUGAZI Jr. – the continuing saga of the GRAMPS/ GRAMPS Plus – now as a compact powerhouse that packs a blend of fuzz, distortion, overdrive and boost. Whether you're after subtle boosts or rich, gritty textures, this pedal delivers a versatile range of tones in a small package Next Owner’s Manual Review… IN / OUT Input Input impedance : ~180 kΩ (true bypass / unbuffered) / ~1 MΩ (buffered) Output Output impedance : ~10 kΩ Power DC Input 9–18 V DC , low current draw (no internal battery). Optional adapter: 9–18 V DC , center-negative (BOSS-style, regulated). Push Switch GIMME Mechanical switching (true bypass or buffer*). * Slide switch below output jack selects True Bypass or Discrete JFET Class-A buffer. LED Indicator Status LED LED turns ON/OFF depending on switch state. LED colour is the colour of the day . Potentiometers FUG Squal / fuzz / dirt / distortion BOWL Tone control (bass ↔ treble) OUT Output level – as loud as you want. Or more. Internals * 1 × GAIN jumper 1 × MID trimmer 1 × BIAS trimmer * May vary depending on production day, version and serial number. Dimensions & Weight Size 111.6 × 61.6 × 50.0 mm (L/W/H) Weight ~160 g (0.35 lbs) Colour / Finish May vary depending on season. From Jun 2024: Stockholm White (RAL 9010) with grey / silver print or raw aluminium with black faceplate. FIRST TEST (with FUGAZI first version) FUGAZI Jr. In Company With Other Pedals Want to push your sound further? The FUGAZI Jr. stacks exceptionally well with other pedals — especially other Himmelstrutz designs . Whether you add overdrive, delay , reverb , or even more fuzz, it integrates smoothly and expands your tonal range without getting muddy or unstable. Ready to refine your tone? The Himmelstrutz FUGAZI Jr. is the compact fuzz/fuzztortion that delivers more than expected. Try it and hear how it can reshape your sound.
